description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for converting AG Grid filters into SQL WHERE and HAVING clauses, including handling of date filters and complex filter combinations, specifically for use within the Apache Superset project.

methods.name: escapeSQLString
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in SQL strings to prevent SQL injection

methods.name: validateColumnName
methods.description: Validates a column name to prevent SQL injection, checking length and allowed characters

methods.name: validateFilterValue
methods.description: Validates a filter value for a given operator, ensuring correct type and presence

methods.name: formatValueForOperator
methods.description: Formats filter values according to the operator, adding wildcards for string pattern matching

methods.name: formatDateForSuperset
methods.description: Formats a date string into ISO format with local timezone for Superset compatibility

methods.name: getStartOfDay
methods.description: Returns the start of the day (00:00:00) for a given date string

methods.name: getEndOfDay
methods.description: Returns the end of the day (23:59:59) for a given date string

methods.name: dateFilterToWhereClause
methods.description: Converts a date filter into a SQL WHERE clause segment based on filter type and date range

methods.name: simpleFilterToWhereClause
methods.description: Converts a simple AG Grid filter into a SQL WHERE clause segment, handling special cases for date filters

methods.name: isCompoundFilter
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter is a compound filter

methods.name: isSetFilter
methods.description: Type guard to check if a filter is a set filter

methods.name: compoundFilterToWhereClause
methods.description: Converts a compound filter into a SQL WHERE clause segment, combining conditions with logical operators

methods.name: convertDateFilter
methods.description: Converts a date filter into a SQLAlchemy filter with TEMPORAL_RANGE operation for Superset

methods.name: convertAgGridFiltersToSQL
methods.description: Main function to convert AG Grid filter model into SQLAlchemy filters, separating dimension and metric filters
